new_targets.why: gemini-cli (107,106★) is Google's open-source Gemini CLI agent — an MCP client and server in a single terminal binary used by developers daily. Tool dispatch (MCP tool calls + built-in tools like shell, file read/write, web fetch) fires under the user's OAuth credential with no per-invocation identity mandate. This is the first CLI-tier agent in the target pipeline. Bolyra's EVC verifier as an optional pre-tool hook gates which mandates authorize which tool classes, turning the CLI into an identity-bound execution environment for agentic sessions. Highest-visibility merge opportunity in the CLI tier.
new_targets.gap: gemini-cli's tool dispatch (packages/core/src/core/tool_executor.ts or equivalent) calls registered tools after LLM selection with no caller-identity check. An optional BolyraAuthMiddleware in the tool execution path — evaluated before each tool invocation — adds per-action mandate binding. Non-breaking: absent the middleware, behavior is unchanged. A contrib packages/bolyra/ directory keeps it self-contained.
new_targets.anchor_issue: Search google-gemini/gemini-cli issues for 'authorization', 'tool permission', 'access control', or 'identity'. At 838 open issues with an active contributor community there is almost certainly demand for per-tool or per-session authorization. Google Gemini team actively reviews external contributions — active maintainer (updated 2026-09-21).
new_targets.pr_type: targeted contrib — optional pre-tool authorization hook in the tool executor + BolyraAuthMiddleware helper in packages/bolyra/. TypeScript strict. Non-breaking.
new_targets.builder_notes: Entry point: study packages/core/src/core/ and the tool execution pipeline. gemini-cli uses pnpm workspaces, TypeScript strict, Vitest. Run pnpm test before submitting. The fact that gemini-cli is both an MCP client and server makes the Bolyra integration doubly compelling: it gates both built-in tools and MCP server tools in a single hook. CONTRIBUTING.md exists.

new_targets.why: AutoGPT (187,471★) is the original autonomous agent and has the highest star count of any target identified across 12 weeks of scanning. The platform ships a plugin/skill ecosystem where agents dispatch web search, file write, shell execution, and external API calls with no per-agent identity mandate. AutoGPT's enterprise positioning and the Platform (autogpt.net) make it the highest-reach target in the pipeline. A BolyraCredential plugin type — registered in autogpts/autogpt/autogpt/plugins/ using the existing PluginType pattern — adds mandate-bound authorization to any AutoGPT task execution without touching core agent logic.
new_targets.gap: AutoGPT's command/plugin execution (autogpts/autogpt/autogpt/agents/ and autogpts/autogpt/autogpt/commands/) dispatches registered commands after LLM instruction with no per-command identity gate. An optional bolyra_mandate field in the AgentSettings configuration and a pre-command hook in the command registry closes the gap. BolyraPlugin registered in plugins/ is the non-breaking extension point.
new_targets.anchor_issue: Search Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT issues for 'authorization', 'permission', 'identity', or 'mandate'. At 585 open issues with an enterprise-oriented maintainer team, demand for per-task identity binding is highly likely. The platform is actively maintained (updated 2026-09-21).
new_targets.pr_type: targeted contrib — optional BolyraPlugin in autogpts/autogpt/autogpts/autogpt/plugins/ + optional bolyra_mandate config field. Python 3.11+. Non-breaking: disabled by default.
new_targets.builder_notes: Entry point: study autogpts/autogpt/ — specifically commands/, agents/, and plugins/. AutoGPT uses Poetry, Python 3.11+, black/isort/mypy. Run make check-code before submitting. The AutoGPT Platform (hosted product) means a merged integration PR here has downstream reach to the hosted user base — high-visibility beyond stars alone. CONTRIBUTING.md exists and the team actively reviews external contributions.

new_targets.why: AgentScope (32,099★) is Alibaba's open-source multi-agent framework — it ships MCP support, service tool dispatch, memory, multi-modal, and real-time voice agents, with an active research and enterprise user base. The ServiceToolkit — which is how agents call external functions, web APIs, and MCP tools — dispatches calls with no per-agent caller identity. AgentScope's explicit goal of 'agents you can see, understand and trust' aligns directly with Bolyra's mandate model: adding an optional pre_service_call authorization hook turns that claim from aspiration to proof.
new_targets.gap: AgentScope's ServiceToolkit.run() (agentscope/service/service_toolkit.py) dispatches registered service functions after LLM request with no identity verification. An optional BolyraServiceAuth contrib wrapper in agentscope/contrib/bolyra/ that wraps ServiceToolkit and verifies a Bolyra mandate before each call closes the gap without changing core code.
new_targets.anchor_issue: Search agentscope-ai/agentscope issues for 'authorization', 'permission', 'access control', or 'identity'. At 396 open issues with an active research+enterprise contributor community (updated 2026-09-21), authorization demand is highly likely, especially for multi-agent delegation scenarios where a sub-agent's tool calls should be bounded by the parent's mandate.
new_targets.pr_type: targeted contrib — BolyraServiceAuth wrapper in agentscope/contrib/bolyra/ + optional pre-call hook. Python 3.10+. Non-breaking.
new_targets.builder_notes: Entry point: study agentscope/service/service_toolkit.py and existing contrib/ patterns. AgentScope uses Python 3.10+, ruff, pytest. Run python -m pytest tests/ before submitting. The multi-agent delegation use case — where a sub-agent's service calls are bounded by the orchestrator's Bolyra mandate — is a compelling demo aligned with AgentScope's architecture. CONTRIBUTING.md exists.

new_targets.why: pentagi (24,813★) is a fully autonomous AI pentesting agent — it dispatches offensive security tools (port scanning, exploit execution, credential testing, vulnerability analysis) through a multi-agent pipeline with no per-session identity mandate. This is the most security-aligned Bolyra fit in 12 weeks of scanning: pentesting agents operating without identity binding ARE the threat model Bolyra was designed to prevent. A BolyraMandate gate before offensive tool execution adds the authorization layer that distinguishes authorized red-team runs from unauthorized use — a compliance and legal necessity for enterprise adoption. First Go-tier target in the pipeline.
new_targets.gap: pentagi's tool dispatch pipeline (internal/providers/ or internal/tasks/ in Go) fires offensive tool functions after LLM planning with no caller-identity or authorization-scope check. An optional bolyra_mandate configuration field on the PentestSession type and a pre-tool middleware in the provider pipeline closes the gap. Non-breaking: without the field, behavior is unchanged.
new_targets.anchor_issue: Search vxcontrol/pentagi issues for 'authorization', 'audit', 'identity', or 'scope'. At 71 open issues with an active security-researcher community, authorization boundary and audit-trail demand is very likely — enterprise security teams need provable scope for penetration testing engagements.
new_targets.pr_type: targeted contrib — BolyraMandate middleware in a contrib/bolyra/ directory + optional bolyra_mandate field on the session config. Go 1.21+. Non-breaking.
new_targets.builder_notes: Entry point: study the tool provider and task execution pipeline in internal/providers/ or internal/tasks/. pentagi uses Go modules, golangci-lint. Run make lint and go test ./... before submitting. The audit-trail angle — every offensive tool call linked to a Bolyra mandate that identifies the authorized operator, expiry, and scope — is the primary value proposition for enterprise red-team workflows. This would be Bolyra's first Go integration PR.

new_targets.why: microsoft/agent-framework (13,673★) is Microsoft's newer unified agentic orchestration framework for Python and .NET — distinct from semantic-kernel (covered week 7), it provides ChatCompletionAgent, multi-agent workflows, and orchestration patterns for production deployments. As a Microsoft-branded agent framework with Python and .NET support, a Bolyra integration here would be the highest-credibility enterprise signal in the pipeline: Microsoft's own deployment framework with an identity-bound authorization layer. Tool dispatch in ChatCompletionAgent runs with no per-invocation mandate check.
new_targets.gap: ChatCompletionAgent's tool execution (python/packages/autogen-agentchat/ or dotnet/src/Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Agents.*) dispatches functions after LLM selection with no caller-identity gate. An optional BolyraAgentMiddleware for Python and a BolyraKernelPlugin for .NET add mandate verification at tool dispatch. Both follow the existing AgentChatMiddleware / KernelPlugin patterns in the framework.
new_targets.anchor_issue: Search microsoft/agent-framework issues for 'authorization', 'tool permission', or 'identity'. At 616 open issues with an active Microsoft engineering team (updated 2026-09-21), enterprise authorization demand is very high — this is a Microsoft-backed framework targeting production enterprise deployments.
new_targets.pr_type: targeted contrib — BolyraAgentMiddleware for Python in python/packages/autogen-ext/autogen_ext/contrib/bolyra/ + BolyraKernelPlugin for .NET in dotnet/src/. Both non-breaking.
new_targets.builder_notes: Entry point: study the Python package structure (python/packages/autogen-agentchat/) and existing middleware patterns (autogen-ext). Python 3.11+, pyproject.toml, mypy, pytest. For .NET: dotnet/src/ with C# nullable reference types. The dual Python+.NET scope makes this a larger PR — recommend starting with Python only and noting .NET in the PR description as future work. CONTRIBUTING.md exists with a Microsoft CLA requirement.
